parties.counterparty: Marshall & Ilsley Corporation acting through its division M&I Data Services ("M&I")

plans.note: Section 13 contains the full damages architecture: 13.1 direct damages only (p0198), 13.2 mutual consequential waiver (p0205), 13.4 M&I total liability cap (p0207, amount appears REDACTED - worker to read for cap size, mutuality and carve-outs for IP/confidentiality/indemnity). Also check the ACH-specific liability limit at p0117 (limits M&I liability to errors caused solely by gross negligence/willful misconduct) as a service-specific narrowing of the cap. Do not double-flag the Termination for Convenience/Cause fees here; those sit under LD/T4C.

14.2 Indemnity is present with both directions: Customer-side indemnity (p0219) and M&I-side indemnity (p0220); 14.3 procedures at p0221-p0224. Worker to test whether M&I's indemnity covers third-party IP infringement and its own misconduct, and whether the Customer-side indemnity at p0219 is unduly broad (breadth of Customer indemnity is the likely deviation, not absence). p0114 is a mutual Applicable Law/ACH indemnity in the ACH section.

No non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer surfaced; the only 'compet-' hit is 'court of competent jurisdiction' (p0298). Worker should confirm nothing in 21.11 Future Acquisitions (p0281) operates as a restriction on Customer's businesses; if not, treat as not applicable/absent with no redline.

No express 'sole supplier' language found, but the appointment section (sec-3, beginning p0056), 21.10 Affiliates (p0280 - all processing for Customer and its Affiliates), 21.11 Future Acquisitions (p0281) and Section 10 pricing premise (p0183) may function as de facto exclusivity / all-requirements commitments. Worker to read sec-3 in full and assess.

Two independent searches for most favored/favoured nation, best price and comparable-customer pricing returned no hits. Treat as absent; no MFN burdens Customer, and the absence of an MFN in our favour is a nice-to-have only.

22.14 Solicitation (p0302) is mutual and Term-limited on its face. Worker to check duration (Term plus any tail), whether it extends to 'hire' as well as 'solicit', and whether a general-advertising/unsolicited-applicant carve-out exists; a missing advertising carve-out is a rationale note unless the ban is effectively a no-hire.

11.1 (p0187) gives Customer termination for convenience on one year's notice but conditions it on a Termination for Convenience Fee (REDACTED % of Estimated Remaining Value) - assess notice length and penalty against the playbook. p0189 Termination for Cause Fee; p0190 no fee where M&I Event of Default; p0263 no-penalty termination after a Disaster; p0125 M&I unilateral termination of EFT services. Also review sec-12 remedies for any M&I walk-away right.

2.1 Initial Term (p0054) and 2.2 Extensions (p0055 - M&I must submit a written renewal proposal at least 18 months before expiry). Worker to confirm whether extension is by mutual agreement (good for us) or auto-renews, and note the long 18-month lead time and any price-uplift mechanics.

22.1 governing law = Wisconsin internal law (p0286); 22.2 exclusive venue in Milwaukee County and E.D. Wis. (p0287). Wisconsin is outside the accepted list but this is a Wisconsin-Wisconsin deal with courts (not foreign arbitration) - likely a rationale note rather than a deviation. Also read sec-15 Dispute Resolution for any mandatory arbitration/escalation and p0299 (attorneys' fees, references arbitration).

22.4 Assignment (p0289) bars assignment by either party including by operation of law, but appears to carve out an assignment pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party - confirm scope for affiliates/successors. p0284 (21.9/B Change in Control of Customer: M&I agrees to continue) and Section 11.3 'Termination Following Change in Control of Customer' (sec-11) must be read together to see whether M&I can exit or reprice on our change of control; 'Control' defined at p0031.

17.1 (p0243) confirms Customer is sole and exclusive owner of Customer Data - favourable, do not flag. The deviation risk is 10.4 Developed Software (p0185): work created by M&I is M&I's property even if paid for by Customer, with only a partial refund/credit mechanic. Also p0250 (safeguards on Customer Data) and p0313 (source-code use restrictions).

Principal grant is the source-code licence at 23.2 (p0310): non-exclusive, non-transferable, limited to the Term, with use restrictions at p0313 (no sublicense/transfer, internal processing only). Check whether Affiliates and contractors/designees are covered (p0310 references 'or its designee'; p0280 covers Affiliate processing) and whether the licence is revocable. p0120/p0125 cover RDS/EFT software licences that may not be available to Customer.

No audit right running against Customer's usage was found. The audit provisions run the other way and favour us: p0276 (records available for examination by Customer's regulators), p0277 (M&I third-party review of its data centre), p0243 (regulatory examination of Confidential Information). p0273 is a Customer books-and-records covenant. Likely no rule-relevant burden; do not flag clauses that benefit us.

13.5 Liquidated Damages (p0208) expressly characterises the Termination for Convenience Fee and Termination for Cause Fee as reasonable approximations of M&I's loss - liquidated damages payable by Customer, the classic deviation under this rule. Quantum drivers at p0187/p0189 (% of Estimated Remaining Value) and the definition at p0039. Coordinate with T4C so the same fee is not redlined twice: T4C should own the exit mechanics, LD the LD characterisation, unless both are independently breached.

16.1 M&I representations and warranties (p0230 and following A-E) with a full disclaimer of all other warranties at p0236 (all caps, likely excludes merchantability/fitness). Read alongside the Performance Standards regime in sec-9 (p0156 definition, p0158 97.5% availability) which supplies the operative service commitment and remedy. Assess whether a real remedy (credits/reperformance) attaches and whether the disclaimer guts the warranty.

14.1 Insurance is present with CGL (p0212), fidelity/employee dishonesty (p0214), workers' comp (p0215), all-risk property (p0216) and a 30-day notice of change/cancellation plus certificate delivery (p0217). Worker to check limits (may be REDACTED) and note the absence of a cyber/E&O-technology policy in the rationale rather than as a standalone deviation unless materially short.

A minimum monthly fee / Monthly Base Fee take-or-pay structure exists: p0130 (definition), p0149 (payable in advance), p0086 (services bundled into the Base Fee), p0183 (Base Fee pricing premised on a defined services bundle), p0181 (renegotiation if M&I terminates a bundled service) and p0281 (Future Acquisitions pricing premise). Exit exists but is priced (see T4C/LD); assess whether the commitment is escapable without penalty and avoid re-flagging the termination fee.

11.4 Termination Assistance (p0192) is present and reasonably robust: assistance on any termination for any reason, up to six months' continued service at contract rates on 100 days' notice, transition plan, good-faith estimate of expenses, no obligation to take assistance from M&I - but all at Customer's expense and at M&I's then-current rates. Worker to confirm an express obligation to return/deliver Customer Data in usable format (not clearly located; check sec-17 around p0250 and the balance of sec-23) and note any gap.
